result.summary: The page is mostly well rendered, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice with identical imagery and details, which looks like a content/rendering bug.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first two cards are exact duplicates: same bowl image, same '15-25 min' badge, same title 'Green Bowl Poké', and same '€0.90 delivery' fee, so one restaurant occupies two slots.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the data feeding this carousel and verify list keys/mapping so each card renders a distinct restaurant with its own image, time, and fee.
